source.instrument_type_source: Decoded from the OTLP wire form at the capture receiver: the metric data-shape field itself (Gauge, Sum with is_monotonic, Histogram, ExponentialHistogram), which OTLP carries explicitly rather than by naming convention. No type here is derived from a metric name, and none carries the unknown sentinel. A NON-MONOTONIC Sum is recorded as gauge: the inventory vocabulary is Prometheus-shaped and has no UpDownCounter, so this document cannot distinguish an OTLP Gauge from a non-monotonic Sum (cantfind SK-103).
